requirement_vague: Item creation should reject empty title (0 characters).
requirement_precise: Register a new user via POST /api/v1/users/signup with email 'test53@example.com' and password 'validpass123'. Login to get token. Attempt to create item via POST /api/v1/items/ with title as empty string ('') and description 'Test description'. Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The item creation request body is validated by the ItemCreate Pydantic model before create_item runs. An empty string title fails the len(v) < 1 check, and FastAPI returns a 422 validation error for request model validation failures.
